properties.name: Tone casting
properties.description: Shapes a sustained vocal tone into a solid crystalline lattice, clear as glass, that bears weight like stone: walls, beams, or spans up to about 20 m. Works only when ambient sound at her position is 45 dB or lower.

properties.name: Held note
properties.description: A lattice persists only while she sustains its anchoring tone. When the tone stops, the lattice breaks into harmless dust within seconds.

properties.name: Load reading
properties.description: By touching a structure, she perceives how stress is distributed through it and where it will fail.

properties.name: Pitch memory
properties.description: Recalls and reproduces exactly any frequency she has heard once.

properties.name: Air-bound
properties.description: Her casting needs air to carry sound. It fails in vacuum and underwater.

properties.name: Voice strain
properties.description: Sustaining any tone for longer than about ten minutes costs her voice for a day.

visual_traits.descriptor: tall and narrow-shouldered, with a stonemason's forearms
lined, watchful, mouth often slightly open mid-note
dust-pale canvas work apron over a high-collared shirt
chalk white, slate grey, pale glass blue
a brass tuning fork on a cord at her throat

exclusion_candidates.reason: The profile does not connect it to casting or any other property, so carrying it into a fusion would require a link the profile does not establish
A cost of sustaining her own tone; a fusion that does not use her sustained tone has no basis to inherit it
